title: Thrust against rotor speed
finding: From 40 percent throttle up, thrust follows 1.7 g per krpm squared. The 13:25 UTC run reaches 1496 g at 29350 rpm.
chip: Same OpenMotor-2306, two 6S packs, cell calibrated to 1726 g, ESC reversed

caveats.text: Rotor speed assumes 7 pole pairs, the default stored in the capture; the motor's real pole count is not recorded.
One capture per run; the 13:25 UTC run was not repeated.
Propeller and ESC model are not recorded, and no clamp meter was recorded.
Load cell calibration: one 1726 g reference mass, about 0.7 percent from creep during the 40 s recording.
The 13:16 UTC run ends at 70 percent: a pack was pulled during the 80 percent step, so later holds are dropped.

reduction: Logged frames; frames in throttle or speed transients are excluded. Hold markers: median of the last 2 s of each throttle hold; the band is the 25th to 75th percentile. Holds with no pack voltage reading are dropped.
